text: Today, AI can tell you what to change.
But your work lives in your files.
So you drive. And the AI suggests.
You upload. You explain. You copy. You paste. You check.
And when it makes the deck... you rebuild it.
What if it worked the other way around?
Agentic Office works inside your files. The model, the memo, and the deck. Together.
AI that works with your work.
